ci/engine_logging.py::engine_logging_sil.reason: Scratch directory for engine log files; the stdlib makes it 0700 on POSIX.

cli/_duckdb_source.py::acquire_relation:.reason: COPY writes the unmasked source table into the 0700 spill directory run.py makes; the file takes the umask mode inside it.

cli/run/_prepare.py::prepare::tempfile.m.reason: DuckDB spill directory; mkdtemp makes it 0700 on POSIX.

cli/run/_vault.py::_commit_vault::tempfi.reason: Vault staging file; mkstemp makes it 0600 and the engine writer reopens it by path.

cli/run/_vault.py::_commit_vault::os.ope.reason: Reopens the vault staging file to fsync it.
